definitions.explanation: The shape or way one holds and moves the body when performing a physical activity such as a sport. Good フォーム means correct, efficient technique.

definitions.gloss: input form; entry form (web or document)
definitions.explanation: A structured set of fields for entering information, especially on a website. Borrowed from English "form" in the sense of a document to fill in.

examples.japanese: コーチにフォームを{直|なお}された。
{正|ただ}しいフォームで{走|はし}ると{疲|つか}れにくい。
examples.english: If you run with proper form, you tire less easily.

examples.japanese: フォームに{入力|にゅうりょく}してください。
{問|と}い{合|あ}わせフォームから{連絡|れんらく}した。
examples.english: I got in touch through the contact form.

examples.japanese: {申|もう}し{込|こ}みフォームに{名前|なまえ}とメールアドレスを{入力|にゅうりょく}して{送信|そうしん}した。
examples.english: I entered my name and email address in the application form and submitted it.

notes:
Loanword from English "form". The two senses—physical posture and an input form—rarely cause confusion because context makes the meaning clear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- フォームを{直|なお}す: to fix one's form (sports)
- きれいなフォーム: clean, well-shaped form
- {入力|にゅうりょく}フォーム: input form
- {問|と}い{合|あ}わせフォーム: contact form

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {姿勢|しせい}: posture — refers to body position generally; フォーム is specifically the technique for an activity
- {書式|しょしき}: document format/template — the layout of a form, not the act of entering data
